text:
lina: Heads-up — customer reported a connector returned a response that passes model validation but fails our schema gate and got routed to degen. They saw `error: invalid shape` and a charge on their invoice.

samir: Which connector / model? Any logs?

lina: model: open-sim-1, connector: jira-create. Example payload we received: `{"action":"create_ticket","args":["proj-123","Fix bug"]}`

andre: Schema expects `args` to be an object `{project_id, summary}` not an array. Router currently enforces schema strictly.

megan: Important: the Console shows token usage but not reject reason. Customers are confused why they were charged when the call fell back.

samir: Quick note on billing: we count model tokens for the primary attempt. If we trigger a fallback variant, that also gets billed. We do not currently credit rejects automatically.

dev-bot: :warning: Canary alert: schema-rejects rate > 5/min on prod-cluster-3 (last 5m)

lina: Proposal: add `reject_reason` to routing traces and surface in Console per-request detail + a human-friendly tooltip: "structured output mismatch".

andre: Implementation idea: enrich span with `validator.reason` and emit separate metric `schema_reject.v1{route,model,cluster}`. Also allow adapter-level coercion hooks that try simple transforms (array->object) before fallback.

megan: UI ask: if we show rejects per-request, we need a rollout toggle (off by default) and privacy redaction; customers shouldn't see raw payloads without consent.

terry: For rollout, suggest soft-validate mode: router sets header `x-validate-mode: soft` which runs validator but keeps original path; then we attach `validation.score` and optional `coerced=true` if adapter fixed it. sample config:

```
validation:
  mode: soft
  sample_rate: 0.05
  coercion: [array_to_object, enum_coerce]
```

samir: Metrics/rollout plan: 1) enable soft validate 5% global, 2) collect `schema_reject` vs `coercion_success`, 3) if coercion success > 90% and no QoS regressions -> toggle stricter handling on.

lina: Action items: andre to prototype span + metric, terry to draft router header and adapter coercion hook, megan to write Console mockups and privacy notes, samir to update billing docs about reject attribution. Sync in 30m?
